behavior-tests.source: GOB 138 stores fixed physical base 36, an Off Balance requirement and a 15 s melee defense penalty of −10.
behavior-tests.runtime: The bound opponent must satisfy Off Balance before queueing. A landed move uses typed resistance and applies the temporary target defense penalty.
behavior-tests.test: MartialArtsStarterAdmissionMode checks stale and missing-state refusals and a landed special. TimedDebuffsReachNpcContestInputAndExpire verifies the −10 live defense change and removal. PR520 and PR551 verify native admission, damage, costs and timers. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/520 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/551
